name: NumPy and pandas
description: Handle price data in arrays and tables, from returns to rolling volatility.

requires.why: Array work calls and writes Python functions and relies on mutation rules.

lessonObjectives.l1-not-lists: Create arrays and see arithmetic apply to every element at once.
lessonObjectives.l2-shapes-and-axes: Reshape arrays and add up along a chosen axis.
lessonObjectives.l3-masks: Filter an array with a Boolean mask.
lessonObjectives.l4-broadcasting: Predict the result of combining two arrays of different shapes.
lessonObjectives.l5-columns-with-labels: Build a Series and a DataFrame, and select by label and by position.
lessonObjectives.l6-loading-prices: Read a CSV with dates as the index.
lessonObjectives.l7-gaps: Find, fill or drop missing values, and say what each choice does to the result.
lessonObjectives.l8-new-columns: Add columns computed from other columns without a loop.
lessonObjectives.l9-returns-with-shift: Compute simple and log returns with `shift` and `pct_change`.
lessonObjectives.l10-rolling: Compute rolling means and annualised rolling volatility.
lessonObjectives.l11-daily-to-monthly: Resample prices to a lower frequency and choose the right aggregation.
lessonObjectives.l13-joining-on-dates: Merge and align two price tables with different trading days.
